signing.note: Signed by authorised signatory with company seal. Confirm digital/scanned submission with your branch.

channels.title: IndusInd Bank IndusDIRECT
steps: Log in to IndusInd Bank IndusDIRECT portal.
Submit trade documents or check with your Relationship Manager.
Confirm the digital services-EDF workflow with your branch as IndusInd does not publish public menu steps.

channels.title: Email to Branch or Relationship Manager
steps: Open the email draft to your IndusInd branch or Relationship Manager.
Attach the downloaded EDF PDF, the invoice XLSX spreadsheet, and invoice copies.
Send before {dueDate} and request an acknowledgement email or reference number.
Save the bank's written acknowledgement and upload it back to Korra.

channels.title: IndusInd Bank Branch / Trade Desk
steps: Print the downloaded EDF (RBI Annex) and sign it with company seal.
Include invoice copies and service agreements.
Submit at the Trade Desk or branch of IndusInd Bank before {dueDate}.
Collect the stamped acknowledgement copy and upload it to Korra.

email.subject: EDF Submission - {month} - IndusInd Bank (AD Code: {adCode})
email.intro: Please find attached our Export Declaration Form (EDF) and supporting export invoice documents for {month} under FEMA 23(R).
